subject: Initial MAP & Close Cadence Proposal
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP & Close Cadence Proposal

Jordan —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. As promised, I put together a lightweight mutual action plan and close cadence to help us align on milestones, owners, and dependencies. I wanted to share the first draft so we can iterate quickly.

High-level proposed timeline:
- Week 1 (May 18–22): Technical discovery + evaluation sandbox access
- Week 2 (May 25–29): Pilot integration (embedding + prompt flow) and perf baseline
- Week 3 (June 1–5): Security review & legal checklist completion
- Week 4 (June 8–12): Final acceptance & commercial sign-off

Asks:
1) Please review the MAP doc and mark any timeline constraints or missing stakeholders.
2) Confirm who from Acme will own security and legal checkpoints so we can add them as owners.

Google Doc (MAP draft): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9I0J/edit
Attachment (stub): RDW-Acme_MAP_v1.0.gdoc (Google Doc)

I cc'ed Marissa and Monica on ramp and SOW items — they'll own the pilot details. If the timeline above looks tight, we can push the pilot start into the week of May 25.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acmecloud.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & Close Cadence Proposal

Thanks Olga — appreciate the clear draft. A couple quick reactions after looking at the doc:

- Timeline: Week 2 looks aggressive for the pilot integration given our internal backlog. Can we shift the pilot to start Jun 1 instead of May 25?
- Security: We need a formal security checkpoint before pilot data ingress. That means an internal security contact (I'll loop legal/security).
- Contracting: Legal will want to see a short SOW and call out data residency for the pilot.

I'll loop our security lead (cc'd legal now) and propose Jun 1 pilot start. Can your SOW template call out the pilot scope + data residency?

Olga / Monica —

Looping back with my suggested edits after Jordan's note. Key changes I pushed into the draft:

- Pilot start moved to Jun 1 (respects Acme backlog)
- Added a "Security Gate" milestone before any pilot data is uploaded: checklist includes threat model review, approved ingress route, and encryption key ownership
- Added a short SOW section called "Pilot Scope (week 1–2)" that calls out sample dataset size, retention window, and a single point of contact for support

I uploaded an internal copy with tracked changes here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9I0J/edit (same doc, under comments).
Attachment (internal stub): SOW_template.pdf

Proposal for next steps:
- Share updated MAP with Jordan/legal and ask for a single security contact (deadline: 2026-05-19)
- Run a 30-min alignment call week of May 25 to lock owners and acceptance criteria

Marissa

Date: 2026-05-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Updated MAP v1.1 — security gate & revised pilot start

Jordan / legal team —

Thanks for the quick feedback and for confirming the pilot timing. We've incorporated the security gate and moved the pilot start to the week of June 1. Attached is the updated MAP (RDW-Acme_MAP_v1.1.docx) and a short SOW PDF (SOW_Acme_v1.pdf) that calls out data residency and pilot scope.

Key updates in v1.1:
- Pilot start: week of 2026-06-01
- Security Gate: clearly enumerated checklist and owner (please confirm Acme's security contact by 2026-05-19)
- SOW: includes pilot dataset size, retention, and acceptable use notes

Next steps:
1) Jordan / Acme legal: confirm security contact and any required edits to data residency language (target: 2026-05-19)
2) Schedule 30-min alignment call the week of May 25 — Marissa will send an invite
3) Once security contact is confirmed, we'll provision the sandbox and share access details

Attachments: RDW-Acme_MAP_v1.1.docx (map), SOW_Acme_v1.pdf (SOW)

Thanks,
Olga
